events.text: The 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit is held in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, which coincides with the country's Independence Day and the opening ceremony of the 2026 World Nomad Games.
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations reports that a tanker was struck by a unknown projectile while transiting yesterday through the Strait of Hormuz near Khasab, Oman.

A spokesperson for the United States Central Command reports that the U.S. military has launched strikes on two Iranian rocket launchers at Larak Island in the strait that were used by Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, its first strikes ag
The Washington Post reports that military leaders have warned U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth against prolonging the war in Iran to 2027.
Sudan's doctors network reports that five civilians have been killed and thousands have been displaced during attacks by Rapid Support Forces in Bara, North Kordofan.
Niger's army says that they have regained control of a airbase after it was attacked by mutiny soldiers yesterday.
A orangutan named Sampurna is reported to be rescued from a haze fire zone in Ketapang, West Kalimantan on Indonesia's Borneo island.
The Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force ship JS Kunisaki departs from a port in Kure, Japan to help fight forest fires in Indonesia.
A passenger ferry, sailing from Cyprus to Turkey, capsizes in the eastern Mediterranean sea. The ship was carrying 259 passengers and 8 crew members, of which 237 people have been rescued.

The body of the last missing individual aboard a boat capsized on Thursday on Mapanuepe Lake in San Marcelino, Zambales, Philippines, is recovered, concluding search operations with the final death toll at nine.

events.topic: 2026 state visit by Xi Jinping to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
events.text: Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan arrive at Manas International Airport in Kyrgyzstan for the upcoming Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek and a state visit to the country.
One person is killed and five others are injured in a mass shooting at a rave in Aarau, Aargau, Switzerland. The perpetrator is on the run.
Eleven people are shot, two fatally, during a mass shooting at a gathering in Trenton, New Jersey, United States

The Korean Central News Agency reports that general No Kwang-chol has been dismissed as defence minister of North Korea, with Korean People's Army General Political Bureau director Kim Song-gi replacing him.

NASA launches the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope aboard a Falcon Heavy rocket from Florida, United States, to survey the universe, study dark matter and dark energy, and search for exoplanets and supernovae.
